requiredInvariants.rule: Before sending consent, atomically persist local consent bound to protocol version, encounter identity, both device identities and both pet identities. A tap/send enqueue/RAM flag is not durable consent.
requiredInvariants.negative: Crash after button input but before persist; peer/pet changes before delayed CONFIRM.

requiredInvariants.rule: Encounter identity is canonical and direction-independent where compared, while each receipt has explicit sender/recipient roles. Bind fresh transcript/nonces and persistent monotonic IDs; reconnect resumes the same durable encounter, never assigns new reward IDs for retries.
requiredInvariants.negative: A/B role reversal; A and C share counter1; stale nonce/session payload replay; integer overflow.

requiredInvariants.rule: Remote durable receipt must explicitly attest its own committed consent/identity/proof stage. Local receipt of ACK, send() success, gift persist, RSSI, nonce or successful connection alone cannot substitute.
requiredInvariants.negative: Send queue accepts but packet never reaches peer; ACK before peer NVS commit; fabricated legacy gift evidence.

requiredInvariants.rule: One local completion transition appends exactly one peer_complete event and its permanent completion/dedup watermark in one validated single-blob commit. Publish success/send committed proof only after success; ambiguous persistence blocks writes and requires reload.
requiredInvariants.negative: Fail between watermark and event; event FIFO full; write returns uncertain after actual commit; restart/replay after phone ACK removed event.

requiredInvariants.rule: Define completion as a local durable knowledge state, not simultaneous mutual knowledge. Last-message loss may leave asymmetric peer states; show pending/locally committed/remote proof observed separately. Retransmit stable proof after restart without replaying one-shot rewards.
requiredInvariants.negative: Drop last DONE/receipt forever; A committed then B resets; arbitrary ACK-of-ACK loss. Never infer both screens completed simultaneously.

requiredInvariants.rule: gift and peer_complete are distinct event kinds and dedup namespaces. Legacy schema2 gift/first-outgoing/peer ACK/RAM completeCount migrate with no encounter completion invented.
requiredInvariants.negative: One-way flower only; old peer record with both gift directions; gift and completion delivered/ACKed in either order.

requiredInvariants.rule: Bounded capacities remain explicit: encoded blob<=8192, FIFO<=200, peers<=32, safe integer counters. Completion capacity is reserved or commit fails unchanged with retryable status; never evict unACKed event or permanent completion proof to make room.
requiredInvariants.negative: 200th/201st FIFO, 32nd/33rd peer, all maximum IDs, 32 pending encounters, peer with full historical metadata, exhaustion during inbound completion.

requiredInvariants.rule: Provide exact worst-case encoded-size arithmetic and actual encoder tests, plus 32KiB NVS old/new blob and garbage-collection allocation budget. An8192 array or existing5739-byte sample is not migration/GC proof.
requiredInvariants.negative: Maximum schema2 migration plus new pending proof; alternating full blob writes across pageGC, no erase/reinitialize on ENOSPC.

requiredInvariants.rule: Migration preserves schema2 identity, snapshot, owner request/seq/hash/result, next counters, pending200 FIFO order/IDs, all32 peers/outgoing states, gift receipts and ACK watermarks. New encounter fields initialize explicitly unknown/not completed. Reject truncated/unknown/corrupt bytes without resetting.
requiredInvariants.negative: Valid schema2 at all capacity boundaries; CRC mismatch/unknown schema; persist failure before/after migration; idempotent reload/migrate.

requiredInvariants.rule: State downgrade boundary must be explicit.038 decoder accepts only schema2. Overwriting its state key with a new schema prevents038 domain load. Keeping an old key permits baseline byte preservation only;039 progress and later038 writes can fork. Do not claim lossless rollback without a tested reconciliation/disable boundary.
requiredInvariants.negative: 039 completion pending then038 rollback and new care/snapshot then039 return; device/event counter reuse across forks; dual-key partial commit.

requiredInvariants.rule: Old026 handshake allows extra capability strings. Mere advertisement of encounter capability is not failclosed. Require explicit compatible activation/version gate and preserve unsupported FIFO head/noACK/no mutation. New event is never disguised as gift(peerComplete=true) or care.
requiredInvariants.negative: Actual unmodified026 HELLO+state+events+pump/ACK retries; old client reconnecting to new completed event; missing capability; malformed/unknown event; race with existing pending journal.

requiredInvariants.rule: Phone consumes new event through durable Native receipt before ACK, with exact encounter+device+pet matching and idempotent ledger/relationship write. Duplicate/receipt/ACK retry must not regrant flower, add friend twice or alter old care cooldown.
requiredInvariants.negative: Native seal succeeds but reply lost; pause before ACK; app restart; wrong current pet; old receipt; duplicate counter from different device.

requiredInvariants.rule: Store mutex encloses all core mutations and proof validation/commit; send callback only queues immutable copied bytes, never waits/reenters or holds UI/radio lock. Delayed events must match current peer/session/consent generation.
requiredInvariants.negative: Disconnect/cancel while queued proof sends; blocked queue; callback reentry; concurrent snapshot/ACK/peer mutation; stale pointer lifetime.

requiredInvariants.rule: Consent withdrawal/expiry/supersession and post-commit dismissal have separate meanings. Cancellation before commitment cannot complete; committed historical proof cannot be silently deleted by dismissing UI. No clock-validity dependency or reset can fabricate elapsed consent.
requiredInvariants.negative: Cancel at every message/persist boundary; clockfalse/offset change; timed-out peer reconnect; hold release leaking into PET.

requiredInvariants.rule: Protocol receipts are uncredentialed device statements, not authenticated account identity, signature, precise distance or anti-cloning guarantee. Host virtual two-machine proof and one-board fixtures must retain their evidence labels.
requiredInvariants.negative: Clone/public deviceId collision; synthetic peer fixtures; no second physical radio. Never claim dual-radio or simultaneous physical completion.
